courses.title: Building AI Agents for DevOps Engineers
courses.description: Building AI Agents for DevOps Engineers focuses on building intelligent agents for people working toward a DevOps Engineer (AI Specialization) role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces prompt engineering, enough to apply alongside building intelligent agents in real DevOps Engineer (AI Specialization) work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to building intelligent agents and show how prompt engineering supports it.

It's built for people who already have some grounding in continuous integration and want to go further.
